The '''Tellanada system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Bruanii sector/Legends|Bruanii sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]].<ref name="Western Reaches" /> It was home to the [[Tellanadan moonflower]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]].<ref name="TEGTW" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tellanada system was first mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square K-18.<ref name="EAOC" />
